rules.rule: Students must meet a second/foreign language requirement
rules.evidence: Students completing a Bachelor of Arts program must meet a second/foreign language requirement that is taught at Franciscan University of Steubenville or for which an appropriate examination can be given.

rules.rule: Foreign language requirement can be fulfilled by demonstrating proficiency at the intermediate level
rules.evidence: Students may earn credits on their transcripts and fulfill the second/foreign language requirement by demonstrating proficiency at the intermediate level (e.g., transfer credit, or credit by examination such as the CLEP or AP exams).

rules.rule: Courses for the foreign language requirement may not be foreign literature courses conducted in English
rules.evidence: These courses may not include foreign literature courses conducted in English.

rules.rule: Foreign language requirement can be satisfied by transfer credit with appropriate proficiency demonstration
rules.evidence: Students may earn credits on their transcripts and fulfill the second/foreign language requirement by demonstrating proficiency at the intermediate level (e.g., transfer credit, or credit by examination such as the CLEP or AP exams).

rules.rule: Foreign language requirement can be satisfied by credit by examination (CLEP or AP exams)
rules.evidence: Students may earn credits on their transcripts and fulfill the second/foreign language requirement by demonstrating proficiency at the intermediate level (e.g., transfer credit, or credit by examination such as the CLEP or AP exams).

rules.rule: Waiver exam may satisfy the foreign language requirement with an appropriate score, but does not provide university credits on transcript
rules.evidence: Franciscan University offers a waiver exam that may satisfy the second/foreign language requirement with an appropriate score; however, this exam does not provide university credits for the student on the transcript.

rules.rule: American Sign Language (ASL) counts as foreign language credit if it meets intermediate level two proficiency requirement
rules.evidence: American Sign Language (ASL) counts for foreign language credit similar to any other foreign language that is not offered at FUS (ex: Italian, Chinese). The requirements for ASL are the same as those for any other language, with intermediate level two proficiency required.

rules.rule: ASL credit may be transferred according to the University's transfer policy
rules.evidence: Though Franciscan University does not offer ASL, students may transfer credit according to the University's transfer policy.

rules.rule: Academic minor requires minimum credits
rules.evidence: A minor requires a minimum of 18 semester credit hours with a 2.00 quality point average.

rules.rule: Academic minor requires minimum GPA
rules.evidence: A minor requires a minimum of 18 semester credit hours with a 2.00 quality point average.

rules.rule: Transfer students must earn upper-level credits at Franciscan for minor qualification
rules.evidence: To qualify for an academic minor, transfer students must earn at least 6 graded semester credit hours in upper-level classes at Franciscan University of Steubenville.

rules.rule: All associate degree programs require final credits earned at Franciscan
rules.evidence: All associate degree programs require that the final 15 credits be earned at Franciscan University of Steubenville.

rules.rule: Associate degree programs require overall GPA
rules.evidence: An overall quality point average of 2.00 in all courses as well as a 2.00 average in the major courses is required.

rules.rule: Associate degree programs require major GPA
rules.evidence: An overall quality point average of 2.00 in all courses as well as a 2.00 average in the major courses is required.

rules.rule: Second bachelor's degree requires minimum additional credits
rules.evidence: A minimum of 30 semester credit hours, beyond those earned prior to awarding of the first degree, must be completed with a 2.00 QPA.

rules.rule: Second bachelor's degree requires minimum GPA
rules.evidence: A minimum of 30 semester credit hours, beyond those earned prior to awarding of the first degree, must be completed with a 2.00 QPA.

rules.rule: Second bachelor's degree earning BA requires modern or classical language requirement
rules.evidence: Current core and major curriculum requirements must be fulfilled including the modern or classical language requirement if a Bachelor of Arts degree is being earned.

rules.rule: Second major post-degree requires major GPA
rules.evidence: A 2.00 QPA in the major field of study must be earned.

rules.rule: Second major post-degree from BS to BA requires modern or classical language
rules.evidence: If the previous major earned a Bachelor of Science degree, but the new degree is in the Bachelor of Arts area, the modern or classical language requirement must be met.

rules.rule: Minimum credit hours required for baccalaureate degree
rules.evidence: Earn a minimum of 124 credit hours for a baccalaureate degree or 60 credit hours for an associate degree, including core and major requirements, with the necessary grade point average (2.00 minimum in the major and overall).

rules.rule: Minimum credit hours required for associate degree
rules.evidence: Earn a minimum of 124 credit hours for a baccalaureate degree or 60 credit hours for an associate degree, including core and major requirements, with the necessary grade point average (2.00 minimum in the major and overall).

rules.rule: Minimum GPA in major and overall
rules.evidence: Earn a minimum of 124 credit hours for a baccalaureate degree or 60 credit hours for an associate degree, including core and major requirements, with the necessary grade point average (2.00 minimum in the major and overall).

rules.rule: Minimum credits from Franciscan University for baccalaureate degree
rules.evidence: For the baccalaureate degree, a student must take at least 30 credits from FUS With approval of the department chair, students may be allowed to take up to 6 of the final 30 credits at another institution, otherwise they will take the final 30 from FUS.

rules.rule: Maximum transfer credits allowed for baccalaureate degree (of final 30)
rules.evidence: For the baccalaureate degree, a student must take at least 30 credits from FUS With approval of the department chair, students may be allowed to take up to 6 of the final 30 credits at another institution, otherwise they will take the final 30 from FUS.

rules.rule: Minimum credits from Franciscan University for associate degree
rules.evidence: For the associate degree, a student must take at least 15 credits from FUS. With the approval of the department chair, students may be allowed to take up to 3 of the final 15 at another institution; otherwise, they will take the final 15 from FUS.

rules.rule: Maximum transfer credits allowed for associate degree (of final 15)
rules.evidence: For the associate degree, a student must take at least 15 credits from FUS. With the approval of the department chair, students may be allowed to take up to 3 of the final 15 at another institution; otherwise, they will take the final 15 from FUS.

rules.rule: Minimum upper-level credits in major at FUS for baccalaureate degree
rules.evidence: Complete a minimum of 12 credit hours in upper-level courses with your academic major at FUS for a baccalaureate degree and a minimum of 6 for an associate degree.

rules.rule: Minimum upper-level credits in major at FUS for associate degree
rules.evidence: Complete a minimum of 12 credit hours in upper-level courses with your academic major at FUS for a baccalaureate degree and a minimum of 6 for an associate degree.

rules.rule: Minimum credit hours required for minor
rules.evidence: Minors must include at least 18 credit hours of required courses, with a minimum of 6 credits earned at FUS.

rules.rule: Minimum credits at FUS for minor
rules.evidence: Minors must include at least 18 credit hours of required courses, with a minimum of 6 credits earned at FUS.

rules.rule: Minimum cumulative GPA for graduation with honors
rules.evidence: To qualify for honors, students must attain at least a cumulative grade point average of 3.5 as determined by the Registrar.

rules.rule: Cum laude honor GPA minimum
rules.evidence: The qualifying cumulative grade point averages determine the following honors at the time of graduation: 3.50-3.699, cum laude; 3.7-3.899, magna cum laude; and 3.9-4.00, summa cum laude.

rules.rule: Magna cum laude honor GPA minimum
rules.evidence: The qualifying cumulative grade point averages determine the following honors at the time of graduation: 3.50-3.699, cum laude; 3.7-3.899, magna cum laude; and 3.9-4.00, summa cum laude.

rules.rule: Summa cum laude honor GPA minimum
rules.evidence: The qualifying cumulative grade point averages determine the following honors at the time of graduation: 3.50-3.699, cum laude; 3.7-3.899, magna cum laude; and 3.9-4.00, summa cum laude.

rules.rule: Minimum credit hours at FUS for transfer students to qualify for honors
rules.evidence: Transfer students must earn a minimum of 62 credit hours at Franciscan University in addition to maintaining a cumulative grade point average of 3.5 or higher.

rules.rule: Minimum GPA for transfer students to qualify for honors
rules.evidence: Transfer students must earn a minimum of 62 credit hours at Franciscan University in addition to maintaining a cumulative grade point average of 3.5 or higher.

rules.rule: Minimum additional credit hours for second degree from same institution to qualify for honors
rules.evidence: Students who return to the University for a second degree, with their first degree from the University, must earn an additional minimum of 30 semester credit hours to be eligible to graduate with honors.

rules.rule: Maximum credits to complete after spring semester to participate in August commencement (undergraduate)
rules.evidence: Undergraduate students must have eight or fewer credits to complete after the spring semester.

rules.rule: Maximum remaining credits for Graduate Business to participate in commencement
rules.evidence: Graduate Business: no more than six credits hours remaining.

rules.rule: Maximum remaining credits for Graduate Catholic Studies to participate in commencement
rules.evidence: Graduate Catholic Studies: no more than eight credit hours remaining.

rules.rule: Maximum remaining credits for Graduate Criminal Justice to participate in commencement
rules.evidence: Graduate Criminal Justice: no more than eight credit hours remaining.

rules.rule: Maximum remaining credits for Graduate Nursing to participate in commencement
rules.evidence: Graduate Nursing: no more than eight credit hours remaining.

rules.rule: Maximum remaining credits for Graduate Philosophy to participate in commencement
rules.evidence: Graduate Philosophy: no more than six credit hours remaining.

rules.rule: BA/BS major programs require a minimum of 24 credit hours in upper level courses
rules.evidence: Each BA/BS major program consists of elementary courses and a minimum of 24 credit hours in upper level courses in which a student must earn at least a C (2.00) average.

rules.rule: Students in upper level courses must earn at least a C (2.00) average
rules.evidence: Each BA/BS major program consists of elementary courses and a minimum of 24 credit hours in upper level courses in which a student must earn at least a C (2.00) average.

rules.rule: Bachelor of Arts programs require intermediate knowledge of a modern or classical language
rules.evidence: Intermediate knowledge of a modern or classical language is required in all Bachelor of Arts programs.

rules.rule: Minimum credits required for graduation
rules.evidence: Sufficient elective course credits to complete at least the 124 credits needed for graduation are required.

rules.rule: Maximum credits from AP/CLEP/IB/DANTES/DSST exams combined
rules.evidence: A maximum of 36 credits can be awarded from a combination of these exams (maximum of 30 credits from CLEP or International Baccalaureate).

rules.rule: Maximum credits from CLEP or International Baccalaureate specifically
rules.evidence: A maximum of 36 credits can be awarded from a combination of these exams (maximum of 30 credits from CLEP or International Baccalaureate).

rules.rule: Transfer course must be worth at least 2/3 of the FUS equivalent credit value
rules.evidence: To meet a Franciscan University requirement, a class must be worth at least 2/3 of the credit required for the FUS equivalent.

rules.rule: Developmental and remedial courses cannot be applied to degree requirements
rules.evidence: These courses cannot be applied to degree requirements and therefore will not transfer.

rules.rule: Bachelor of Arts/Science: Must complete final 30 consecutive credits at FUS
rules.evidence: Bachelor of Arts/Science: Students must complete their final 30 consecutive credits at FUS.

rules.rule: Bachelor of Arts/Science: May take up to 6 of final 30 credits elsewhere with department chair approval
rules.evidence: With approval of the department chair, students may be allowed to take up to 6 of the final 30 credits at another institution.

rules.rule: Bachelor of Arts/Science: Must complete at least 12 upper-level credits in major at FUS
rules.evidence: They must also complete at least 12 upper-level credits in their major at Franciscan.

rules.rule: Associate of Arts: Must complete final 15 consecutive credits at FUS
rules.evidence: Associate of Arts: Students must complete their final 15 consecutive credits at FUS.

rules.rule: Associate of Arts: May take up to 3 of final 15 credits elsewhere with department chair approval
rules.evidence: With the approval of the department chair, students may be allowed to take up to 3 of the final 15 at another institution.

rules.rule: Associate of Arts: Must complete at least 6 upper-level credits in major at FUS
rules.evidence: They must also complete at least 6 upper-level credits in their major at Franciscan.

rules.rule: Minor: Must complete at least 6 of 18 required credits in upper-level classes at FUS
rules.evidence: Students must complete at least 6 of the 18 required semester credit hours in upper-level classes at Franciscan.

rules.rule: Internship credits do not transfer
rules.evidence: Internship credits do not transfer to Franciscan.

rules.rule: Maximum 15 credits for general electives with no FUS equivalent
rules.evidence: A maximum of 15 credits for general electives may be awarded for courses with no FUS equivalent (e.g., Emergency Medical Technician coursework).

rules.rule: Pass/fail grades do not transfer unless officially verified as equivalent to C or higher
rules.evidence: Pass/fail grades do not transfer unless the credit-granting institution can officially verify a pass grade is equivalent to a C grade or higher.
